`crabbymetrics` is a Rust-backed econometrics library with a compact Python API. This homepage is the entry point for the standalone docs pages in `docs/`.

## Main Reference

- [API reference](api.html): verified public surface, library sitrep, summary schemas, and runtime smoke checks.

## Self-Contained Examples

- [OLS](examples/ols.html): baseline linear regression with HC1 standard errors.
- [ElasticNet](examples/elastic-net.html): regularized linear regression.
- [Logit](examples/logit.html): binary logistic regression.
- [Multinomial Logit](examples/multinomial-logit.html): multiclass classification.
- [Poisson](examples/poisson.html): count regression.
- [TwoSLS](examples/twosls.html): instrumental variables regression.
- [FTRL](examples/ftrl.html): online-style binary classification.
- [MEstimator Poisson](examples/mestimator-poisson.html): callback-driven estimation matched against built-in Poisson.

## Notes

- `api.qmd` remains the main documentation page and renders to `api.html`.
- The example pages are standalone Quarto documents, not a shared website shell.
- All pages are rendered with embedded resources so the checked-in HTML files are self-contained.
